criteria.name: Data Understanding & Quality Checks
criteria.guidance: Assess dataset structure, target variable, data types, missing values, duplicates, inconsistent values, and data-quality risks.

criteria.name: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
criteria.guidance: Assess univariate/bivariate analysis, plots, class balance, and explanations of patterns relevant to loan default.

criteria.name: Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering
criteria.guidance: Assess missing-value handling, duplicates, encoding, scaling where appropriate, leakage prevention, and feature engineering rationale.

criteria.name: Linear Model Building
criteria.guidance: Assess baseline classifier, train/test split, preprocessing, target mapping, and assumptions.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Assess confusion matrix, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC where appropriate, interpretation, limitations, and actionable findings.
